lesson_1.title: The Gates of Syntax
lesson_1.story_intro: You stand before the massive stone Gates of Syntax. To pass, you must prove you can store information.
lesson_1.lesson_text: In Python, we use 'variables' to store data. Example: name = 'Hero'
lesson_1.challenge_objective: Create a variable named 'player_name' and set it to your own name.
lesson_1.success_node: The gates grind open! Welcome, {player_name}. You have mastered the first fundamental.
lesson_1.error_hint: Make sure you typed 'player_name' correctly and used quotation marks for your name!
